description: Long tool turn: one bash call that sleeps ~50s (a stand-in for a long build or test run), then a final answer. Used to verify that the foreground service keeps a backgrounded, screen-off turn alive (BACKLOG B-1/B-12). Start the mock, send one message, immediately press Home + power off the screen; the turn must complete and the sentinel must appear in the transcript.

steps.reasoning: Long-running work: let the turn prove it survives backgrounding and screen-off.
The sleep completed while the app was in the background; report it.
steps.text: The long tool call completed and printed its sentinel.
